'''Endrolian ground-apple juice''' was a type of juice<ref name="GG9" /> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Endrolia system/Legends|Endrolia system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During storage, it often unintentionally fermented and thus became [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]]. The resultant [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverage]] was sought-after, albeit not easy to procure, by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="GG9" />

==Behind the scenes==
Endrolian ground-apple juice was mentioned in the [[1993]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', which was written by [[Simon Smith]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] for [[West End Games]].<ref name="GG9" />
